scripts.docker:login: dotenv -e .env.local -- bash -c 'REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"; aws ecr get-login-password --region "$REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text).dkr.ecr.$REGION.amazonaws.com"'
scripts.docker:push: dotenv -e .env.local -- bash -c 'REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"; ENV="${PETLOG_ENV:-dev}"; ACCOUNT_ID=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text); docker tag petlog-frontend:latest "$ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$REGION.amazonaws.com/petlog-frontend-$ENV:latest" && docker push "$ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$REGION.amazonaws.com/petlog-frontend-$ENV:latest"'
scripts.docker:force-redeploy: dotenv -e .env.local -- bash -c 'REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"; ENV="${PETLOG_ENV:-dev}"; aws ecs update-service --region "$REGION" --cluster "petlog-cluster-$ENV" --service "petlog-frontend-$ENV" --force-new-deployment >/dev/null'
scripts.docker:deploy: npm run docker:login && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push && npm run docker:force-redeploy
